summary: Delivery4817 source extends the maintained external-reference Orca observer with a separately held current-public local inspect/save/inspect/replay/restore/replay/dispose journey. The existing external command-recovery sequence, execute_session supervisor and cleanup function retain their AST; the navigation helper preserves legacy defaults while selecting the exact FourD root for new controls. A None admission rejects the actual new entry before files, signals or qualification. Authenticated full preflight must separately join actual observer/controller revision and bytes, typed-plan digest, original template producer/archive, existing mechanical-validator bytes and actual producer custody. Current DOM reference-only custody is refused. The existing mechanical validator checks original browser report hashes and typed case identities; no package/version/case registry is copied. The new binder requires exact state/counters/fixed coordinates, the polite live region, phase-bounded original Orca speech, real key/focus order and observed control removal, while retaining original native exit, process/bus/browser/terminal evidence checks. Partial local observations preserve an earlier cause when reporting also fails. Sixteen actual Python tests and the retained observer pure suite with logging controls disabled passed under finite1CPU/512MiB aggregate-RSS bounds, with no Node, GI, SDK, browser or AT execution. Embedded companion changes only bounded local status/counter projection; its added causal JS handler control is source-prepared but unrun. The existing observation schema and native300+30s/2GiB/4MiB limits remain. Local storage is synthetic in-memory; durable-save, provider-matrix, native-IME and whole4817 acceptance stay false. The accepted capability map remains the full applicability baseline; existing D5 owns provider generation, and maintained Studio observer/caller adaptation remains separate required work. Original custody, mapping and log-budget failures are retained; later emptiness does not clear them. Full current-public custody/caller integration, actual protected source CI, native runtime selection, current Studio/provider applicability and actual IME remain open. This source does not run or accept a native journey.
title: Held current-reference Orca local save journey preserves existing custody and acceptance scope
